cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: Directly uses ZipEntry.getName() to construct file path without path traversal validation, matching CWE-22: Path Traversal vulnerability where malicious zip entries could write outside destination directory
Writes file content to potentially malicious path constructed from untrusted zip entry name without validation, enabling path traversal attacks per CWE-22
